7524.title: Redundant command output survives pruning
7524.rootCauseOneLine: Resolved-item pruning requires an earlier delta before deletion, so the first command delta survives even when a started item and completed output already exist.
7524.proposedFix: Use the started command item as an ordering witness when completed output exists; explicitly revisit settled history. Stored-data changes exclude an automatic fix under this rule.
7524.caveats: Real-provider update frequency and installation-wide totals were not measured. Full monorepo build hit unrelated missing Plugin SDK dist files; both scoped reproductions ran and 55 relevant existing tests passed. Complete reproduction test is inline in the report.
